uncited: Hierarchical DDA Traversal extends standard DDA [DDA](2323-dda.md) to efficiently traverse sparse, multi-resolution volume structures by adapting step sizes to the current tree level .

Unlike sibling methods that step voxel-by-voxel [Amanatides-Woo Voxel Traversal](3132-amanatides-woo-voxel-traversal.md) or use fixed-resolution grids [3D Bresenham Voxel Traversal](3951-3d-bresenham-voxel-traversal.md), this family skips empty internal nodes or adjusts mip-levels dynamically to balance speed and precision .
The core mechanism involves maintaining DDA state (`mNext`, `mDelta`, `mStep`) relative to a current dimension `mDim` .
Originated in sparse voxel grid rendering, specifically for VDB structures .
Developed to address the inefficiency of voxel-by-voxel traversal in large, sparse datasets .
